story_overview: Members of a group, including Leo, Clara, and Martin, participate in interviews in The Study and The Portrait Room. In parallel, Ansel and Martin are at The Poolside Patio, showing off features of the house like a retractable screen door while other characters interact nearby.

video_prompts:
Leo: Man with short, salt-and-pepper hair and a neatly-trimmed goatee, wearing a solid blue crew-neck t-shirt and the beaded stone necklace.
The Portrait Room: An interview room with framed pictures on the wall and a plant.
the abstract art prints: A collection of rectangular, abstract art prints in simple, thin, black wooden frames under glass, featuring geometric shapes in muted palettes of blue, grey, and beige.
the fiddle leaf fig plant: Large Fiddle Leaf Fig plant with broad, glossy, violin-shaped green leaves sprouting from a slender brown woody trunk, housed in a simple white ceramic cylindrical pot.
Owen: Man with short dark hair, wearing an unbuttoned grey plaid button-up shirt over a plain white t-shirt

Close-up shot of Leo in The Portrait Room during an interview. He speaks earnestly while looking slightly off-camera. In the background behind him, the abstract art prints hang on the wall and the fiddle leaf fig plant stands in the corner.

Ansel: Man with long, straight dark hair, wearing glasses and a pink polo shirt with thin white and blue stripes.
The Poolside Patio: A lush backyard featuring a pool, a red brick patio, green trees, and a round outdoor table.
the black poodle: Large Black Poodle with a thick, fluffy, and curly black coat.

Ansel watches as the black poodle walks across the red brick patio in front of him.

Martin: Man with short, solid grey hair and a goatee, wearing thick-framed glasses and a pink polo shirt with wide, horizontal stripes.
the white french doors: A set of white, multi-paned French doors.
the swimming pool: Rectangular in-ground swimming pool with clear, light blue water and a brick coping edge.

Ansel opens the white french doors. He and Martin step out onto the brick patio, looking around at the lush backyard and the swimming pool as they talk.
